title: Installed generator and reader workload identities
question: Do the installed generator and selected-read workloads establish complete determining code identity?
method: Inspect actual entry callables and distinguish coarse discovery diagnostics from required eager initialization and binding unknowns.
conclusion: The shared implementation establishes bounded callable proofs and verifies executing source custody. The four installed workloads still contain required initializers or imports without a closed execution contract, so no production reuse was eligible in this observation.
